001package dayplanner;
002
003import javax.swing.JComboBox;
004
005/**
006 * Represents the Swing GUI combo box to select a command.
007 */
008public class GUICommandMenu extends JComboBox<String> {
009    /**
010     * Menu options displayed in the command selection combo box.
011     */
012    private static final String[] OPTIONS = {
013        "< Select a Command >",
014        "Add - Insert a new activity",
015        "Search - Search for an activity",
016        "Quit - Exit DayPlanner" };
017
018
019    /**
020     * Create a new Swing GUI picker.
021     * 
022     * @param gdp        Refers to the Swing GUI window.
023     * @param activities Instantiated ActivityList.
024     */
025    public GUICommandMenu(GUIDayPlanner gdp, ActivityList activities) {
026        super(OPTIONS);
027
028        addActionListener(e -> {
029            int index = getSelectedIndex();
030            if (index <= 0)
031                return;
032
033            MenuOption option = MenuOption.parse(index);
034            if (option == null)
035                return;
036            
037            // Execute the desired task.
038            switch (option) {
039                case ADD:
040                    new GUIAddWindow(activities);
041                    break;
042                case SEARCH:
043                    new GUISearchWindow(activities);
044                    break;
045                case QUIT:
046                    new GUIQuitMenu(gdp);
047                    break;
048                default:
049                    break;
050            }
051
052            // Immediately show the "Select Command" item.
053            setSelectedIndex(0);
054        });
055    }
056}
